task_description: Replace the fragile session-dependent bare-EC2 benchmark launch that burned ~$353 without producing a single measurement with a self-driving, progressively validated harness. Deliver: a zero-spend preflight gate plus free AWS prerequisites (S3 results bucket, SSM-capable IAM instance profile) and closure of the leftover 0.0.0.0/0 SSH group and unusable key pair; a user-data bootstrap that mounts the 30.4 TB of local NVMe the prior run ignored, guards free space before downloading, streams logs, results and GPU telemetry to S3 and CloudWatch continuously, handles spot interruption, and self-terminates on both completion and a hard wall-clock deadline; a launcher gated behind CONFIRM_SPEND=yes; a stub-based bash test harness so all of that is exercised on a GPU-less sandbox; a staged runner (preflight -> c5d.large plumbing -> g6e.xlarge GPU smoke -> p5en.48xlarge full) with swappable recipe files for the three credible H200 configurations; an S3 checkpoint mirror so retries never re-download 151 GB; a results collector matching the JSON schema compare-results.sh already parses; and documentation (runbook, postmortem, README factual corrections). No EC2 instance is launched and no compute is billed by any feature in this task. FEAT-004 adds the operator-requested stop-and-summarize checkpoint: once a run on H200 or B300 succeeds even once, the staged runner refuses further paid GPU stages until a written summary of that run exists.
spend_policy: The orchestrator has NOT granted approval to launch EC2 capacity. Every feature validates with run-instances --dry-run and the stub harness only. Free, non-compute AWS mutations that ARE authorised: create the S3 results bucket, create the IAM role and instance profile, revoke the SSH 0.0.0.0/0 rule on sg-0775ac013a1b6080d, delete the unusable key pair tpot-bench-key. What a later approved run would cost: p5en.48xlarge spot in us-east-2a at $26.66/hr, bounded by MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES=240 to about $107 worst case; the optional plumbing stage on c5d.large is a few cents and the gpu-smoke stage on g6e.xlarge is well under a dollar.

verification.summary: Build = bash -n across scripts/*.sh, scripts/bootstrap/*.sh, tests/run-tests.sh and scripts/recipes/*.env: exit 0. Tests = bash tests/run-tests.sh: 22 cases / 220 assertions, exit 0, and the suite touches no real AWS resource. Test quality independently verified by the orchestrator, not just self-reported: five surgical breaks were applied to throwaway copies of the repo and each flipped exactly the intended case with no false positives elsewhere. Pass 1 removed the pre-download disk guard, hardcoded the RAID0 --raid-devices count and un-exported RESULTS_DIR in compare-results.sh, turning cases 2, 3 and 13 red. Pass 2 neutralised the summary gate (cases 16, 17, 19 red) and then, separately, let CONFIRM_SPEND=yes bypass the summary gate, which case 16 caught: that is the exact defence-in-depth bypass the acceptance criteria were written to prevent. docker_build skipped because the repo has no Dockerfile; it is a bash plus AWS CLI harness with nothing to containerise. No EC2 instance was launched and nothing was billed by any feature: describe-instances for pending/running is empty, no open or active spot request exists, the results bucket holds 0 objects, git tracks only results/.gitkeep, and the working tree is clean.
verification.spend_incurred: $0 of compute. The only AWS mutations were the free ones authorised in the spend policy: created S3 bucket tpot-bench-results-077090643075-us-east-2, IAM role tpot-bench-ec2-role with the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore attachment and the scoped inline policy tpot-bench-scoped-access, IAM instance profile tpot-bench-ec2-profile, revoked the SSH 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on sg-0775ac013a1b6080d, and deleted the unusable key pair tpot-bench-key.
verification.not_validated_without_gpu: Every GPU-side behaviour remains unproven because the sandbox has no GPU and nothing was launched: whether --moe-runner-backend marlin loads the W4A16 path on H200, whether --speculative-algorithm DSPARK exists in the image (it appears only in the cookbook, not in the published server_arguments table), whether sglang serve is available versus python3 -m sglang.launch_server, and the actual nvidia-smi and NVIDIA-runtime paths. The plumbing (about $0.01) and gpu-smoke (about $1.21) stages exist specifically to de-risk these before any H200 spend.
